summary: Uses Qwen Server VAD and streaming ASR to emit observational speech state and transcripts; a Voice Turn Controller owns cancellation.

region.description: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio region used to build the recommended workspace-specific realtime WebSocket endpoint.

vad_threshold.description: Server VAD sensitivity. Lower values trigger more easily; tune this value in the Studio Node configuration.

ignore_filler_utterances.description: Legacy-only exact filler suppression. Standard graphs delegate admission to builtin.voice_turn_controller.

ignored_utterances.description: Deployment-owned exact filler/non-speech transcripts for legacy graphs. Unknown input always passes through.

barge_in_requires_final.description: Legacy mode only: wait for a validated final transcript before emitting the legacy interruption Signal.

emit_legacy_barge_in_signal.description: Compatibility escape hatch for pre-controller graphs. New graphs must leave this false and route final transcripts through builtin.voice_turn_controller.
